description: This file defines the TwitchClientManager class responsible for managing Twitch chat client connections, including creating auth providers, handling message events, sending messages, and managing client lifecycle.

classes.name: TwitchClientManager
classes.description: Manages Twitch chat client connections, including authentication, message handling, and client lifecycle management.

methods.name: createAuthProvider
methods.description: Creates and returns an auth provider (StaticAuthProvider or RefreshingAuthProvider) based on account configuration.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Retrieves an existing or creates a new ChatClient for a given Twitch account.

methods.name: setupClientHandlers
methods.description: Sets up message and event handlers for a given ChatClient.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Registers a message handler callback for a specific Twitch account.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects and removes a client associated with a given Twitch account.

methods.name: disconnectAll
methods.description: Disconnects all active clients and clears handlers.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a specified Twitch channel.

methods.name: getAccountKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key string for a Twitch account.

methods.name: _clearForTest
methods.description: Clears all clients and handlers, intended for testing purposes.
